html: שׁפח (√ of foll.; cf. Sab. ספח pour, also n. מספחת effusion (?) DHMVOJ ii (1888), 189 HomChr 124; Arabic سَفَحَ pour out water, shed blood; note (with ref. to etym. of foll. words) phr. سَافَحَهَا commit fornication with her (Lane), i.e. effudit cum ea (sc. semen) Fl in De Jes 3:78 Anm.; on Ph. שפח servant (?) cf. HoffmPh. Inscr. 18 Lzb 381).
